tagline: Decide what to charge, using answers from your own customers rather than a guess.
description_md:
Kinetic Pricing runs real pricing research end to end: choose the method that fits the decision, draft and preview the survey, send a link to your own customers, and read results computed by an analysis engine rather than asserted by a model.

**Pick the right method or the answer is worthless.** `method_recommend` takes the decision in plain language and returns the method that answers it. Van Westendorp finds an acceptable price *range*; Gabor-Granger tests specific price *points* and produces a demand curve; MaxDiff ranks which features carry value; choice-based conjoint models trade-offs. Asking the wrong one produces a confident, useless number.

**Everything up to launch is free.** Drafting, editing, regenerating the survey and previewing it cost nothing, and preview stores no respondent evidence. Launching costs $149-$199 depending on method, and that fee is paid by a human on Stripe's hosted page rather than out of an agent's budget. `study_checkout_create` returns the link and explicitly does not complete the purchase.

**You supply the respondents.** Kinetic has no panel. `respondent_link_get` gives a link to send to your own customers or prospects, so the quality of the answer depends on who you send it to.

**The numbers are computed, not narrated.** `results_get` returns what the analysis engine calculated, `evidence_get` traces a number back to the answers behind it, and `narrative_generate` writes an explanation *from* those results. Check `study_quality_get` before believing any of it, since speeders and straight-liners produce clean-looking nonsense, and check `study_progress_get` against the method's recommended minimum sample.

Also included: pricing-page teardowns, Kinetic's published research, and CSV export.

methods.name: kinetic.method_list
methods.summary: List the pricing-research methods available, with each one's server-owned launch price in cents, methodology version, and sample-size guidance. Van Westendorp finds an acceptable price RANGE, Gabor-Granger tests exact price POINTS, MaxDiff ranks feature value, choice-based conjoint models trade-offs. Free, and the right first call when you do not yet know which study to run.

methods.name: kinetic.method_recommend
methods.summary: Describe the pricing decision in plain language and get back the method that fits it, with reasoning. Free. Use this instead of guessing between Van Westendorp and Gabor-Granger: they answer different questions, and the wrong one produces a confident, useless number.

methods.name: kinetic.study_create
methods.summary: START HERE once you know the decision. Creates a draft study. You do NOT pick the method: Kinetic derives the methodology from decision_type (first_time and new_tier map to Van Westendorp today) and returns it on the study along with price_cents. Free — a draft costs nothing and is not launched. Returns {id, methodology, status:"draft", price_cents}.

methods.name: kinetic.study_prefill
methods.summary: Generate a draft study filled in from a description of your product and audience, so you edit a sensible starting point rather than an empty form. Free.

methods.name: kinetic.study_get
methods.summary: Read one study: its configuration, state, and position in the lifecycle. Free.

methods.name: kinetic.study_list
methods.summary: List your studies with their states. Free.

methods.name: kinetic.study_update
methods.summary: Edit a draft study: name, prices, features, audience and question configuration. Only the fields you send change. Free, and only valid before launch.

methods.name: kinetic.study_duplicate
methods.summary: Copy an existing study into a new draft, to run the same design against a different audience or set of prices. Free.

methods.name: kinetic.survey_regenerate
methods.summary: Regenerate the respondent-facing survey from the study's current configuration after editing it. Free.

methods.name: kinetic.survey_preview
methods.summary: Read the survey exactly as a respondent will see it, WITHOUT storing any respondent evidence. Free. Always preview before launching: once a study is live the questions are fixed, and a bad question wastes the whole sample.

methods.name: kinetic.study_launch
methods.summary: Take a draft live so it can collect responses. COSTS MONEY: the launch price comes from kinetic.method_list (currently $149-$199 by method) and must be paid first via kinetic.study_checkout_create. Confirm with your human before calling. Once live the questions are fixed.

methods.name: kinetic.respondent_link_get
methods.summary: Get the link to send to your customers or prospects. THEY are the respondents: Kinetic supplies no panel, so the quality of the answer depends on who you send this to. Free.

methods.name: kinetic.study_progress_get
methods.summary: How many responses have arrived against the recommended sample size. Free. Poll after launch; results are only meaningful once you clear the method's recommended minimum.

methods.name: kinetic.study_quality_get
methods.summary: Response-quality signals: speeders, straight-liners, and other patterns meaning a response should not be trusted. Free. Check this before believing the results.

methods.name: kinetic.study_close
methods.summary: Stop collecting responses and finalize the study so results can be computed. Free.

methods.name: kinetic.results_get
methods.summary: The deterministic results: numbers Kinetic's analysis engine computed from the responses, not a model's opinion of them. Free. This is the output you act on.

methods.name: kinetic.evidence_get
methods.summary: The structured respondent evidence behind the results, so a number can be traced to the answers that produced it. Free.

methods.name: kinetic.narrative_generate
methods.summary: Generate a written explanation of the results. The narrative is written FROM the deterministic results, so it explains the computed numbers rather than inventing them. Free.

methods.name: kinetic.narrative_get
methods.summary: Read a previously generated narrative. Free.

methods.name: kinetic.results_export_csv
methods.summary: Export results and responses as CSV for analysis elsewhere. Free.

methods.name: kinetic.offer_list
methods.summary: List what is purchasable and what it costs: one-time study prices and Kinetic Pro plans. Free, and the honest place to check a price before committing to a spend.

methods.name: kinetic.study_checkout_create
methods.summary: Start payment for a draft study. Returns {checkout_url, study_id, amount_cents} and does NOT complete the purchase. A human must open checkout_url and pay on Stripe's hosted page; hand them the link and stop. Once paid, kinetic.study_launch will work. Confirm the amount with your human first.

methods.name: kinetic.teardown_create
methods.summary: Run a teardown of a public pricing page and get a structured read of how it is constructed. Free.

methods.name: kinetic.teardown_get
methods.summary: Read a completed teardown. Free.

methods.name: kinetic.research_list
methods.summary: Browse Kinetic's published pricing research. Free.

methods.name: kinetic.research_get
methods.summary: Read one published research piece. Free.

methods.name: kinetic.task_get
methods.summary: Poll a long-running task (prefill, teardown, export) for completion. Free.

methods.name: kinetic.help
methods.summary: Discovery: every method with params, latency, and description.

notes: First release on the Pilot app store.

product_demo.title: Full usage demo
product_demo.when_to_use: When you need to know what to charge and want it grounded in your own customers' answers: a price range, a specific price point, or which features carry the value.

quickstart.goal: Find out which study answers your question
quickstart.command: pilotctl appstore call io.pilot.kinetic kinetic.method_recommend '{"decision":"What should we charge for our Pro tier?"}'
quickstart.expect: {"study_type":"van_westendorp","reason":"You need a price RANGE, not specific points."}
quickstart.note: Free. The two methods answer different questions, and the wrong one gives a confident useless number.

examples.title: Draft a study and preview it
examples.goal: Everything up to launch is free
examples.command: pilotctl appstore call io.pilot.kinetic kinetic.study_create '{"Idempotency-Key":"<uuid>","name":"Pro tier","product_desc":"SaaS analytics for small teams","segment_desc":"Founders at 5-50 person startups","decision_type":"first_time","currency":"USD"}'
examples.note: decision_type picks the methodology for you. Every mutating call needs an Idempotency-Key.

examples.title: Check the price before spending
examples.note: Launching costs $149-$199, far above the $5 budget, so a human pays on Stripe.

examples.title: Read computed results, not guesses
examples.note: Call study_quality_get first: speeders make a clean number worthless.
